title: 第1章  女剑仙
content_zh:
“双修？早说啊！你上还是我下！”
楚弛听到女剑仙的要求，期待地搓了搓手，眼神里有野兽一般的光芒。
“你，不怕我将你采补至死？”
楚弛没有废话，只说了五个字：“我先脱为敬！”
一年后。
女剑仙眼神惊讶地道：“你居然这么强，不过是只蝼蚁，居然能坚持这么久……”
楚弛邪邪一笑，猖狂地道：“就这？就这？”
“我都说了，我这方面超顶的，不就是当你的鼎炉吗？谁怕谁！来啊，再来大战三亿回合！”
楚弛又躺了下去。
洞穴秘境里，又传来了楚弛得意自信的声音。
“哈哈哈，剑仙不过如此，服不服！服不服！”
“服！服辣！”
“大声点！服不服！”
时间流逝，十年后。
这十年，楚弛除了短暂的休息，其余时间都在协助女剑仙修炼。
换做普通人，早就面黄肌瘦甚至哀声断气了。
但楚弛却依旧生龙活虎。
“你竟然觉醒了特殊体质，难怪你扛得住！荒古大日体，没错了，你肯定是那种罕见的体质。”
女剑仙眼神忽然变得明亮，非常欣喜，似乎没想到，能遇到这种体质的人。
闻言，楚弛却是相当震惊：“什么？我真是荒古大日体？被那婊子懵对了？”

荒古大日体，十万年难得一遇。
但不是说这种体质有多强，只是因为这种体质，太过特殊，太过另类。
拥有这种体质的人，开枝散叶的能力特别强，没几个人受得了。但所有觉醒这种体质的人，都无法活过二十岁。
因为二十岁的时候，这种体质，会迎来逆天的爆发，体内的至强阳气，会突飞猛涨，如同汪洋大海。
那时候，人会化为野兽。
不管是男人还是女人，甚至不管是不是人，都会受到摧残，就算如此，还是化解不了体内的至强阳气。
所以，觉醒这种体质的人，不是爆体而亡，就是在二十岁生日来临之前自杀、或者被人杀死。
楚弛之所以跳崖，碰到了来此地疗伤的女剑仙，就是因为他的未婚妻，想要悔婚，将他塑造成为了觉醒荒古大日体的邪魔。
他不想被杀死，只能跳崖求生。
“剑仙前辈，你确定，我是荒古大日体？”
“确定！”
“娘希匹的，怪不得我每次去完村尾小翠家都感觉不得劲，原来是我天赋异禀，需求太大。”
女剑仙微笑：“遇到你，是我最大的机缘。”
她拍了拍手。
洞穴深处，忽然走出两道人影。
这两人，同女剑仙长得一模一样。
唯一不一样的，是身上的气息。
那穿白色衣裙的，眼神温柔如水，气息如同暖阳，让人心旷神怡。
穿紫色衣裙的，眼神寒冷如冰，身上有血气和杀意，让人如坠冰窟。
这，三胞胎？

挺刺激啊！
“别惊讶，她们都是我。白色衣裙的，是我善意所化的剑仙善尸，紫色衣裙，是剑仙恶尸。她们也受伤了......”
女剑仙的声音传来。
她身为绝世强者，一心成仙。
但成仙，何其难？
秩序已毁，仙门难入。
她寻了好久，才找到了成仙的办法。
那就是将意识，分裂成三尸。
分别是善尸，恶尸，以及自我尸。
等她斩杀三尸，收道果，就能强行成仙。
但，她小看了自我尸。
自我尸，独我而行，修为居然比本体还强。
关键时刻竟想反杀本体和善恶两尸，夺取成仙契机......她控制善恶尸围攻不敌，逃亡至此。
“接下来，你不仅要助我修行恢复，还要协助我的善恶尸，事成之后，我会报答你。”
时间流逝，三百年后。
楚弛出现在了大山脚下。
他仰着头，看着天上的太阳，眼含热泪。
三百年了，你知道我这三百年是怎么度过的吗？
虽有绝世美人相伴，是非常美妙的事情。
但，再好的风景看久了都会腻。

当然，楚弛还是很感谢女剑仙的，如果不是女剑仙，他就算没摔死，也被体内暴涨的至阳之气，弄得爆体而亡了。
“楚弛，你虽然是荒古大日体，阳气十足，能经得住我的采阳秘术，但你的身体，太弱。
冲天。但，你的修为，至少要提升到魔人境。”
楚弛的脑子里，出现了女剑仙的声音。
他当时就有些懵，还来？
居然还想要？
幸亏我是荒古大日体啊。
“去吧，不是有女人负了你吗？该报仇就报仇。我用了时间神符，秘境三百年，外面七日。”
“剑仙前辈，等一下……我也想报仇，但我天生无法修炼，只是一介凡人，我要怎么报仇啊。”
荒古大日体，因为体内至强阳气的原因，根本无法成为修者。
“剑仙前辈，剑仙姐姐，剑仙姥姥，你还在吗？要是我死了怎么办？”
“你……真啰嗦。看看你识海，我将一尊鼎放在里面了，此鼎材质特殊，能保你小命，另外，我将基础的剑道传承也传给了你。”
“识海？识海和丹田一样，只有成为修者才有，我哪里有……”
这个想法还没有落下，楚弛的身体，忽然出现在了一片黑色海洋之上。
黑海无垠，不见其边。
这，就是识海。
他现在的身体，是由精神凝聚而成。
他的本体，依旧在原地。
识海上空，是氤氲雾气。
想要拨开云雾，看见更广阔的海洋，只能不停变强。

“这是识海？我居然有了识海！这么说，我成为了修者？是同你双修的原因吗？哈哈哈，太好了！”
楚弛太兴奋了！
这世上，没有人不想成为修者。
只有成为修者，才有资格主宰自己的人生。
楚弛之所以被未婚妻设计陷害，就是因为他连修者都不是。
剑仙姐姐真是太好了，不枉他努力耕地三百年！
止住兴奋，他再次开口道：“剑仙姐姐，那就是你给的鼎吗？”
在识海的上方，悬浮着一口黑色的鼎。此鼎，没有任何威压释放，看上去平平无奇。
“看上去很普通啊……难道，宝物都这样低调？这就是所谓的大道至简？”
女剑仙没有解释，因为这口鼎，根本不是什么宝物。
至少，女剑仙得到此鼎后，并未发现此鼎有什么特殊的地方。
这鼎在她眼里，无异于垃圾。
但用来保这小子的命应该暂时足够了。
此刻，识海中。
楚弛见女剑仙不说话，忍不住用手摸了摸这看上去普通的黑鼎。
一瞬间，异变突起！
安静的鼎，忽然发生了震动，似乎与楚弛的身体，产生了感应。
识海中的氤氲雾气，快速涌动，好似一条条云做的神龙。
神龙翱翔，识海颤动。
古井无波的黑色海洋，泛起了滔天浪潮。
content_en:
"Double cultivation? You should have told me earlier! You go up or I go down!"
When Chu Chi heard the female sword fairy's request, she rubbed her hands expectantly, with a beast-like light in her eyes.
"Aren't you afraid that I will feed you until you die?"
Chu Chi didn't talk nonsense and only said five words: "I'll take off my clothes first to show respect!"
One year later.
The female sword fairy said in surprise: "You are so strong, you are just an ant, and you can persist for so long..."
Chu Chi smiled evilly and said wildly: "That's it? That's it?"
"I've already said it, I am the best in this field, so I am your cauldron, right? Who is afraid of whom? Come on, let's fight for another 300 million rounds!"
Chu Chi lay down again.
In the secret realm of the cave, Chu Chi's proud and confident voice came again.
"Hahaha, the Sword Immortal is nothing more than that, do you accept it or not? Do you accept it or not!"
"Serve! Take it hot!"
"Louder! Are you convinced?"
Time passes, ten years later.
In the past ten years, except for a short break, Chu Chi spent the rest of his time assisting the female sword immortal in her training.
If it were an ordinary person, he would have become emaciated and emaciated long ago and even died in mourning.
But Chu Chi is still lively and energetic.
"You have awakened a special physique, no wonder you can withstand it! The Ancient Sun Body, that's right, you must have that rare physique."
The female swordsman's eyes suddenly brightened, and she was very happy. She seemed to have never expected to meet someone with such a physique.
Hearing this, Chu Chi was quite shocked: "What? Am I really the Great Ancient Sun Body? Was I confused by that bitch?"
The ancient great sun body is a rare encounter in a hundred thousand years.
But it doesn't mean how strong this physique is, it's just that this physique is too special and too different.
People with this kind of physique have a particularly strong ability to spread branches and leaves, and few people can stand it. But all those who awaken to this constitution cannot live beyond the age of twenty.
Because at the age of twenty, this kind of physique will usher in a heaven-defying explosion, and the extremely strong yang energy in the body will surge like a vast ocean.
At that time, people will turn into beasts.
No matter whether they are men or women, or even whether they are human or not, they will be destroyed. Even so, they still cannot dissolve the strong Yang Qi in their bodies.
Therefore, people who awaken this kind of constitution will either explode and die, commit suicide before their twentieth birthday, or be killed by others.
The reason why Chu Chi jumped off the cliff and met the female sword fairy who came here to heal was because his fiancée wanted to regret the marriage and shaped him into an evil demon who awakened the ancient sun body.
He didn't want to be killed, so he had to jump off a cliff to survive.
"Senior Sword Immortal, are you sure that I am the Ancient Sun Body?"
"OK!"
"Niang Xipi, no wonder I feel uncomfortable every time I go to Xiaocui's house at the end of the village. It turns out that I am extremely talented and my needs are too great."
The female sword fairy smiled: "Meeting you is my greatest opportunity."
She clapped her hands.
Deep in the cave, two figures suddenly walked out.
These two people looked exactly like the female sword fairy.
The only thing that is different is the breath on his body.
The one wearing a white dress had eyes as gentle as water and a breath like warm sunshine, which made people feel relaxed and happy.
The one wearing a purple dress has eyes as cold as ice, and there is blood and murderous intent on his body, making people feel like they have fallen into an ice cave.
These, triplets?
Quite exciting!
"Don't be surprised, they are all me. The one in the white dress is the good corpse of the Sword Immortal transformed by my kindness, and the one in the purple dress is the evil corpse of the Sword Immortal. They are also injured..."
The voice of the female sword fairy came.
As an extremely powerful person, she is determined to become an immortal.
But how difficult is it to become an immortal?
The order has been destroyed, and it is difficult to enter the immortal gate.
She searched for a long time before she found the way to become an immortal.
That is to split the consciousness into three corpses.
They are the good corpse, the evil corpse, and the self corpse.
After she kills the three corpses and collects the Dao Fruit, she can become an immortal by force.
However, she underestimated her own body.
Self-dead, walking alone, my cultivation is actually stronger than my real body.
At the critical moment, she actually wanted to kill the original body and the two corpses of good and evil, and seize the opportunity to become an immortal... She controlledThe zombies of good and evil were besieged and defeated, so they fled here.
"Next, you will not only help me practice and recover, but also assist my good and evil corpse. After that, I will repay you."
Time passed, three hundred years later.
Chu Chi appeared at the foot of the mountain.
He raised his head and looked at the sun in the sky with tears in his eyes.
It’s been three hundred years. Do you know how I spent these three hundred years?
Although it is a very wonderful thing to be accompanied by a peerless beauty.
However, no matter how good the scenery is, you will get tired of it after looking at it for a long time.
Of course, Chu Chi was still very grateful to the female sword fairy. If it weren't for the female sword fairy, even if he didn't fall to death, he would have been exploded to death by the surge of Yang Qi in his body.
"Chu Chi, although you are an ancient sun body with full yang energy and can withstand my secret technique of harvesting yang, your body is too weak.
Soaring to the sky. However, your cultivation level must at least be upgraded to the demon realm. "
The voice of the female sword fairy appeared in Chu Chi's mind.
He was a little confused at the time. Why come again?
You actually still want it?
Fortunately, I am the ancient sun body.
"Go on, isn't there a woman who betrayed you? Revenge should be taken. I used the time talisman, three hundred years in the secret realm, and seven days outside."
"Senior Sword Immortal, wait a minute... I also want to take revenge, but I am born unable to practice and am just a mortal. How can I take revenge?"
The Ancient Great Sun Body was unable to become a cultivator at all due to the extremely strong yang energy in its body.
"Senior Sword Immortal, Sister Sword Immortal, Grandma Sword Immortal, are you still there? What if I die?"
"You... are so verbose. Look at your Consciousness Sea. I placed a cauldron inside. This cauldron is made of special material and can protect your life. In addition, I also passed on the basic swordsmanship inheritance to you."
"Sea of consciousness? The sea of consciousness is the same as the Dantian. It can only be found by becoming a cultivator. Where can I have it..."
Before this thought could be settled, Chu Chi's body suddenly appeared on a black ocean.
The Black Sea is endless and has no edge.
This is the sea of ​​consciousness.
His current body is made of spirit.
His body is still in place.
Above the sea of ​​consciousness is a dense mist.
If you want to clear away the clouds and see the broader ocean, you can only keep getting stronger.
"Is this the sea of consciousness? I actually have the sea of consciousness! So, I have become a cultivator? Is it because I am a cultivator with you? Hahaha, great!"
Chu Chi is so excited!
In this world, no one wants to be a cultivator.
Only by becoming a cultivator can you be qualified to control your own life.
The reason why Chu Chi was framed by his fiancée was because he was not even a cultivator.
Sister Sword Fairy is so kind, she deserves his three hundred years of hard work in cultivating the land!
Stopping his excitement, he spoke again: "Sister Sword Immortal, is that the tripod you gave me?"
Above the sea of consciousness, there is a black cauldron suspended. This cauldron does not release any pressure and looks ordinary.
"It looks very ordinary... Could it be that all treasures are so low-key? Is this the so-called simplicity?"
The female sword fairy did not explain, because this cauldron was not a treasure at all.
At least, after the female sword fairy got this cauldron, she didn't find anything special about this cauldron.
In her eyes, this cauldron is nothing more than rubbish.
But it should be enough to save this kid's life for the time being.
At this moment, in the sea of ​​consciousness.
Seeing that the female sword fairy was silent, Chu Chi couldn't help but touch the ordinary-looking black tripod with his hand.
In an instant, a sudden change occurred!
The quiet tripod suddenly vibrated, seeming to be interacting with Chu Chi's body.
The dense mist in the sea of ​​consciousness surged rapidly, like dragons made of clouds.
The divine dragon soars and the sea of ​​consciousness trembles.
The black ocean, which had no waves in the ancient well, was filled with huge waves.
